purpose: Keep the complete real-world club squad separate from SWOS's fixed 16-player TEAM record while retaining every verified player for future selection and career tools.

fullModernSquad.label: Full Modern Squad
fullModernSquad.description: All verified first-team/senior players retained by SWOS Studio. This is the authoritative club roster and is not limited to 16 players.

installedSwos16.label: Installed SWOS 16
installedSwos16.description: Exactly 16 players selected from the full modern squad for the physical SWOS TEAM record.

clubSquadPool.label: Club Squad Pool
clubSquadPool.description: Every full-squad player not currently selected in the Installed SWOS 16. Players remain available to the Studio instead of being discarded.

invariants: installedSwos16 must contain exactly 16 unique stable player IDs before a TEAM.* installation can be enabled
every installedSwos16 player must exist in fullModernSquad
a player cannot be present in both installedSwos16 and clubSquadPool
stable player identity is retained when a player moves between layers

careerRules.notes: An established career is its own fictional universe. Real-world football database updates must never be pushed into an existing .CAR automatically.
